name: Grok Build
summary: Terminal-based coding agent for planning, editing, testing, reviewing diffs, and working with subagents in existing repos.
builderUseCase: Ask it to refresh installation docs, generate a plan, apply the diff, and run the local validation command before a human review.
watchItem: Early beta maturity, subscription access, and reliability on larger production repos.

name: Codex
summary: Cloud software engineering agent that can read, edit, run code, work in parallel, and create GitHub pull requests.
builderUseCase: Delegate a scoped issue such as adding filters to this dashboard, then review the resulting branch and test evidence.
watchItem: Environment setup quality, internet access settings, and review discipline for generated pull requests.

name: Jules
summary: Autonomous coding agent that works on GitHub repositories in a VM, runs tests, and opens pull requests.
builderUseCase: Use it for dependency bumps or small framework migrations where test results can prove the change.
watchItem: Task scope definition and how well the generated PR explains decisions.

name: Copilot Cloud Agent
summary: Issue and prompt-driven coding agent that works in the background and can open pull requests from GitHub workflows.
builderUseCase: Create a well-scoped GitHub issue with acceptance criteria, assign Copilot, then review the generated PR.
watchItem: Premium request usage, GitHub Actions minutes, and whether acceptance criteria are specific enough.

name: Claude Code
summary: Agentic coding tool that works from the terminal and can read codebases, edit files, run commands, and integrate with developer tools.
builderUseCase: Use it locally to add a data validator, run tests, and commit changes with a human-readable summary.
watchItem: Permission settings, local command safety, and clear project instructions.

name: Background Agents
summary: Asynchronous coding agents that clone a GitHub repo, work on a branch, and push changes back for handoff.
builderUseCase: Send a background task to add a new launch card while continuing local work in the editor.
watchItem: Repository permissions, branch hygiene, and privacy mode settings.
